scientific_integrity: An explicit finite proof and asymptotic argument are included; exhaustive enumeration is limited to mappings of size at most six and cannot prove an infinite statement. Independent external audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The known cyclic-core forest representation and Prüfer coding are used as prior foundations. Novelty concerns the sharp conditional regression and cross-covariance; potential implicit extraction from historical multivariate generating functions remains a priority risk. No assertion of independence or a joint central limit theorem.
title: A quadratic cyclic-core regression for origins in a uniform random mapping
